[[File:spex camera photographer.jpg|250px|thumb|right]]
The Commonwealth update added a new feature that allows players to take photographs.

== Usage ==
[[File:spex camera seeker.jpg|250px|thumb|right|The view through the seeker]]
1. Add the '''Model PH-324 Camera''' ({{hl|SPEX_K35_PH324}}) through the [[Arma 3 Arsenal]].

2. Add at least one '''35mm 36Rnd Super-XX Film Roll''' ({{hl|SPEX_36rnd_Super_XX_Film}}) through the [[Arma 3 Arsenal]].

3. In game, press {{Controls/Control|B}} to bring up the camera.

4. Look through the seeker by pressing {{Controls/Control|RMB}} and press {{Controls/Control|LMB}} to take a photograph.

{{Feature|informative|Color correction can be applied by pressing {{Controls/Control|Left CTRL}} + {{Controls/Control|RMB}}}}

== Enable Screenshot Creation ==
By default, the camera will not create an actual screenshot.
To enable this, go to

'''Pause Menu''' >> '''Addon Options''' >> '''Spearhead 1944''' >> '''Camera creates a screenshot'''

and tick the box. Now, each time a photograph is taken with the camera, a screenshot is saved in {{hl|<ProfileFolder>/screenshots/SPEX_Film/}}

== Event ==
Every time a photograph is taken, the [[Arma_3:_Scripted_Event_Handlers|scripted event]] {{hl|SPEX_System_Infantry_Camera_Photograph_TakenEvent}} is triggered. Scenario creators or modders can subscribe to that event with

<sqf>[
    missionNamespace,
    "SPEX_System_Infantry_Camera_Photograph_TakenEvent",
    _code
] call BIS_fnc_addScriptedEventHandler;</sqf>

The following arguments are passed to the code.

<sqf inline>params ["_player", "_photoGraphedObjects"]</sqf>
* _player: [[Object]] - The unit who took a photograph
* _photoGraphedObjects: [[Array]] of [[Object]]s - All objects in the view of the player when the photograph was taken
